paite: TOUPA aw, ka lungsim na kiang ah ka koih den zel a.
heading: David La / Makaihna Leh Humbitna Ngetna
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, nang ka hon muang hi, zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla; hon doute hon zoh phal ke'n.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

paite: Ahi, nang hon ngakte kuamah zahlak in a-om kei ding uh. Aziak om lou a lepchiahtak a gamtate zahlak in a-om ding uh.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampite hon theisak inla; na lamtate tanchin hon hilh in.
english: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

paite: Na thutak ah hon pi inla, hon hilh in, nang hon hondampa Pathian na hi ngal a; nitum in ka hon ngak nilouh hi.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lainatna leh na zahngaihnate theigige in; tuma a na om gige sa ahi ngal a.
english: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

paite: Ka valnou lai khelhnate leh ka tatleknate theigige ke'nla; TOUPA aw na hoihna ziak in, na zahngaihna bang zel in hon theigige in.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA zaw a hoih in adik ahi; huaiziak in mikhialte lampi amusak ding.
english: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

paite: Thunuailutte vaihawmna dik ah api ding a, thunuailutte amah lampi tanchin leng ahilh ding hi.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

paite: Athukhun leh athu theihsakte zuite a ding in TOUPA lampi tengteng zahngaihna leh thutak ahi.
english: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min ziak in thulimlouhna ngaidam in, thupitak ahi ngal a.
english: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

paite: TOUPA kihtami kua ahia? Atel ding lampi amusak ding hi.
english: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

paite: Ahinna nuamsatak in a-om ding a; asuante'n gam aluah ding uhi.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

paite: TOUPA thuguk amah laudan siamte kiang ah a-om, athukhun amaute atheisak ding hi.
english: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

paite: Ka mit in TOUPA lam a-en gige a, ama'n ka khete len a kipan in lakhe ding ahi ngal a.
english: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, ka tung ah zahngai in; chim leh haksatak in ka om ngal a.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

paite: Ka lungtang buainate ahong thupita a; ka mangbatna a kipan hon pikhia in aw.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

paite: Ka haksatna leh ka thuakdan ngaihtuah inla, ka khelhnate ngaidam in.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

paite: Hon doute ngaihtuah dih, tampi ahi ua; nakpi petmah in ahon ho behlap uhi.
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

paite: Ka hinna vomhoih inla, hon humbit in aw; zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla, nang ah ka ginna ka koih ngal a.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

paite: Ka lungsim hoihna leh ka dikna in hon humbit in. K'on ngak nilouh ngal a.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

paite: Pathian aw, Israelte mangbatna tengteng ua kipan tankhia in.
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
